problem_context.problem_statement: Create a verification-only callpoint harness, without changing any production C implementation statement, that establishes one shared circular-area backing-buffer contract compatible with allocator-returned uninitialized storage. The current mismatch is: CircularAreaInit returns UCharArray::undef_full while Read, Write, DataLength, Reset, and Release require UCharArray::full. Use the current ArrayLib mixed_full/mixed_seg support to model partially initialized storage soundly. The harness must prove legal composition of successful Init with metadata queries, empty Read, first Write, Reset, and Release; Write followed by Read; repeated Write; Read followed by Write; and release after every reachable state. It must not derive full from undef_full. The canonical shared predicate/spec declarations belong in this case lib and downstream implementation cases will import and use exactly them.
problem_context.expected_behavior: All intended API transitions compose from the exact postcondition of the preceding call. Reads may only access cells proved initialized; writes initialize their destination cells; metadata/reset preserve mixed ownership; release may consume mixed ownership.
problem_context.input_output_contract: No production implementation changes. Verification harness wrappers use concrete descriptor ownership plus a mixed_full backing list and a pure logical relation connecting initialized live ring cells to byte values. Init success starts with repeat None; first write can target None cells; nonempty reads obtain Some values for every live byte.
spec_hint: Define a reusable canonical circular-area resource predicate in xizi_circular_area_callpoint_specs_lib.v.
Keep logical byte contents separate from the list (option Z) used by UCharArray::mixed_full if that makes the read/write relation clearer.
Include exact external API specs and straight-line wrappers for every required transition; prove them by canonical symbolic execution, not by standalone assumptions.
preferred_hidden_properties: Every ring-live index maps to Some of the corresponding logical byte, while free indices may be None or Some.
Reset makes the logical live region empty without claiming that physical bytes became initialized or were erased.
forbidden_patterns: Do not add or use undef_full-to-full, mixed_full-to-full unless the mixed list is definitionally map Some, Admitted, Axiom, or a spec that requires full immediately after Init.
